w, h, t, d := 80.0, 50.0, 6.0, 6.0
sides := doc.Sketch.Rect(V(0, 0, 0), V(w, h, 0))
doc.Constrain.Coincident(sides[0].Start(), doc.Origin())
doc.Constrain.Length(sides[0], w)
doc.Constrain.Length(sides[1], h)
pts := [][2]float64{{10, 10}, {70, 10}, {70, 40}, {10, 40}}
for _, p := range pts {
	c := doc.Sketch.Circle(V(p[0], p[1], 0), d/2)
	doc.Constrain.Diameter(c, d)
	doc.Constrain.Distance(c.Center(), sides[0], p[1])
	doc.Constrain.Distance(c.Center(), sides[3], p[0])
}
sk := doc.Active()
fmt.Println("solved:", sk.Solved(), "DOF:", sk.Dof())
plate := doc.Features.Extrude(t, "plate")
a := plate.Analyze()
fmt.Println("sound:", a.Check().Sound(), "volume:", a.Volume(), "bounds:", a.Bounds())
